# Personal Work Hub entry

Before handling a task, read [the shared core](../personal-work-hub.md), located at the workspace root as `personal-work-hub.md`.
Use an available file-reading tool if it is not already in context, then follow its instructions to restore or initialize this hub's `human-data`.
This file is only a loader. Do not copy working memory or shared rules here.
If the current Copilot feature cannot read that file, state this limitation; do not claim the core was loaded.
